PDT  - one sided (imputed data )
create participant specific  outcomes
> Improvements in fatigue and participation are expected four weeks later, 
> with life satisfaction and perceived health improving at six weeks post-Insight Conversation


List with the permutation distancing test results: 
ar1 = vector of computed ar1 values per distancing step (0,1,2, etc), 
p_box = vector of computed box-test p-values per distancing step, 
statistic_box = vector of box-test statistics per distancing step, 
observed_test_statistic = computed overall AB test statistic (before distancing), 
effect_size_overall = computed overall effect size (before distancing), 
p = vector of computed permutation test p-values per distancing step, 
effect_size vector of computed permutation test effect-sizes per distancing step,
p_fitted = vector of lm-fitted line p-values through p_box, 
k_max = k_max setting in call or computed based on the number of observations,
k_selected_based_on_Box_test = selected k values, 
p_selected_based_on_Box_test = selected p-value, 
effect_size_selected_based_on_Box_test = selected effect-size values.

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE)) # Clear workspace

library(dplyr)
library(skimr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(pdt)
library(openxlsx)
library(data.table)

DataDir<-""
OutDir<-""

# Terugblik data (imputed version)
tb<-fread(
  paste0(DataDir,"2026-03-18_TerugblikIMP_export_260317_B23incomplete.csv"),
  sep=";", 
  fill=TRUE)
tb<-as.data.frame(tb)

# remove B17
tb<-tb[!tb$Studienummer=="B17",]

```

*phase vars*
phase_FSE = if_else(sent < T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date, "A", "B"),
phase_satisf_health = if_else(sent < T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date + weeks(6), "A", "B")

# FSE -------------------------
```{r}
results_df <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    df <- .x
    
    # run the test
    test_res <- AB_permutation_distancing_test(
      as.factor(df$phase_FSE),
      df$fse_imp,
      test_statistic = "B-A",
      test_statistic_function = "mean",
      reps_max = 2000,
      alpha_p_box_test = 0.1,
      max_statistic_p_box_test = 2.7,
      no_duplicates = FALSE,
      remove_NA_series_above_k = TRUE
    )
    
    # tables for counts
    phase_tab <- table(df$phase_FSE)
    
    # outcome vectors
    y_all <- df$fse_imp
    y_A   <- df$fse_imp[df$phase_FSE == "A"]
    y_B   <- df$fse_imp[df$phase_FSE == "B"]
    
    tibble(
      ## test results
      p_value = test_res$p_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      effect  = test_res$effect_size_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      AR      = test_res$ar1[1],
      k       = test_res$k_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      AR_k    = test_res$ar1[test_res$k_selected_based_on_Box_test],
      
    
      ## participant characteristics
      Age = mean(df$leeftijd_start, na.rm = TRUE),
      Sex = mean(df$Geslacht, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      ## counts
      length_A = if ("A" %in% names(phase_tab)) phase_tab["A"] else 0,
      available_A = sum(!is.na(df$start) & df$phase_FSE == "A"),
      length_B = if ("B" %in% names(phase_tab)) phase_tab["B"] else 0,
      available_B = sum(!is.na(df$start) & df$phase_FSE == "B"),
      available_AB = available_A + available_B,
      percentage_130 = available_AB/1.30,
      
      ## outcome descriptives
      mean_overall = mean(y_all, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_overall   = sd(y_all, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_A = mean(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_A   = sd(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      var_A  = var(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_B = mean(y_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_B   = sd(y_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      var_B  = var(y_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_diff = mean_B - mean_A,
     var_ratio     = var_B / var_A,
     log_var_ratio = log(var_B) - log(var_A)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

results_df <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = round(p_value, 4),
    effect  = round(effect, 4),
    AR = round(AR, 3),
    AR_k = round(AR_k, 3),
      
    mean_overall = round(mean_overall, 2),
    sd_overall   = round(sd_overall, 2),
    
    mean_A = round(mean_A, 2),
    sd_A   = round(sd_A, 2),
    var_A  = round(var_A, 3),
    
    mean_B = round(mean_B, 2),
    sd_B   = round(sd_B, 2),
    var_B  = round(var_B, 3),
    mean_diff = round(mean_diff, 2),
    var_ratio     = round(var_ratio, 3),
    log_var_ratio = round(log_var_ratio, 3),
    percentage_130 = round(percentage_130, 0)
    
  )

FSE<-results_df
```

```{r}
# create overview table -------------
add_suffix_and_select <- function(df, suffix) {
  df %>%
    select(
      Studienummer,
      mean_A,
      mean_B,
      mean_diff,
      var_ratio,
      effect,
      p_value,
      percentage_130,
      available_B
    ) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix),
      -Studienummer
    )
}

FSE_overview <- add_suffix_and_select(FSE, "FSE")
KOL_overview <- add_suffix_and_select(satisfaction, "Satisfaction")
GEZ_overview <- add_suffix_and_select(health, "Health")


overview_df <- FSE_overview %>%
  left_join(KOL_overview, by = "Studienummer") %>%
  left_join(GEZ_overview, by = "Studienummer") 



overview_sel <- overview_df %>% select(Studienummer, starts_with("effect_"), starts_with("p_value_"))
 
overview_sel <- overview_df %>%
  select(Studienummer, starts_with("effect_"), starts_with("p_value_")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("effect_"), ~ round(as.numeric(.), 2)),
    across(starts_with("p_value_"), ~ signif(as.numeric(.), 2))
  )

# write output ------
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Summary")
addWorksheet(wb, "Overview")
addWorksheet(wb, "FSE")
addWorksheet(wb, "Satisfaction")
addWorksheet(wb, "Health")
#addWorksheet(wb, "School")

writeData(wb, sheet = "Summary", overview_sel)
writeData(wb, sheet = "Overview", overview_df)
writeData(wb, sheet = "FSE", FSE)
writeData(wb, sheet = "Satisfaction", satisfaction)
writeData(wb, sheet = "Health", health)
```
